newsitem.title: USA: ADC completes Cirrus unit acquisition.
newsitem.headline: ADC completes Cirrus unit acquisition.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Tuesday it completed its acquisition of Pacific Communication Sciences Inc (PCSI), a wholly owned subsidiary of Cirrus Logic, for about $23 million in cash.

PCSI, which provides wireless communication infrastructure equipment, has about 100 employees. It will continue to operate from San Diego and will become part of ADC's newly formed Wireless Systems Group.
"With over 250 employees, ADC's Wireless Systems Group is expected to make a substantial contribution to ADC's revenues in 1997," the company said in a statement.

With PCSI, ADC is acquiring cellular digital packet data base station technology, personal handyphone system base station and system level design capabilities, and an advanced paging base station development business, the company said.
ADC Telecommunications designs, manufactures and markets transmission and networking systems and broadband connectivity products.
